description: Search a curated, human-reviewed log of dated evidence about how fast AI is advancing: measured capabilities (benchmarks, agents, science, robotics, compute, cybersecurity), AI working in the real world, and statements by accountable people. Useful when the user asks whether an AI claim is real or hype, what AI can measurably do today, what a lab actually published, or wants sources on AI progress. Returns signal ids, titles and permalinks; call fetch with an id for the full record and the primary source.

query.description: Keywords, a person, a lab, or a category.

name: search
title: Search signals
